fact: The UNESCO case study of 2021 states that data collected regularly at school level, such as attendance of students and teachers, are not centrally stored; that the School Management Information System (SMIS) has been piloted, with its national rollout in question for want of internet coverage and suitable computers; and that the EMIS Action Plan to move school management functions from paper to tablets in primary and secondary schools has not been put into practice for lack of resources.
title: Strengthening Education Management Information Systems (EMIS) and Data for Increased Resilience to Crisis. Country Case Study: Ethiopia
